description: This file defines types, classes, and functions for managing session registry in Playwright, including loading, storing, and retrieving session data, as well as handling file system interactions and client info creation.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Manages session files, allowing loading, retrieval, and updating session entries from the filesystem.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session file by client info and session name.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Retrieves all session files associated with the given client info.

methods.name: entryMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of session files.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a session entry from disk and updates internal registry.

methods.name: _loadSessionEntry
methods.description: Reads and parses a session file from disk.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads all session files from the base daemon directory.
